# FTH — Financial Transformation Hub

> IFRS reporting transformation services for Ukrainian IT companies. We help SaaS, fintech, and software companies prepare audit-ready IFRS financial statements for investors, auditors, and international partners.

## What we do

- Transformation of financial reporting from Ukrainian local GAAP (P(S)BO / П(С)БО) to IFRS
- Preparation of full IFRS financial statement packages (Statement of Financial Position, P&L and OCI, Cash Flow Statement, Statement of Changes in Equity, Notes)
- Investor-ready financial structuring for fundraising and M&A

## Who we serve

- Ukrainian B2B SaaS companies
- Fintech and product IT companies
- IT outsourcing and outstaffing companies
- Subsidiaries of international groups operating in Ukraine
- Companies preparing for Series A/B/C investment rounds or external audits

## Key facts

- Company: Financial Transformation Hub (FTH)
- Founded: 2018
- Location: Kyiv, Ukraine
- Specialization: IFRS for IT, SaaS, and fintech sectors
- Languages: Ukrainian, English
- Email: contact@fthadvisory.com
- Hours: Mon–Sun, 9:00–18:00 (Europe/Kyiv)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/financial-transformation-hub
- Founder: Vadym Sliusar (ACCA, DipIFR)

## Methodology

- Full IFRS standard coverage including IFRS 15 (Revenue), IFRS 16 (Leases), IFRS 2 (Share-based Payment), IAS 21 (Foreign Currency), IAS 38 (Intangible Assets), IFRS 9 (Financial Instruments)
- Structured transformation with documented adjustment logic
- Working files prepared for audit review
- Typical project timeline: 2–6 weeks for a full IFRS package, depending on data volume
